description: Cargo and mail via Doha International Airport by type, year and month is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset contains data on cargo and mail handled at Doha International Airport in 2015, categorized by type (Dispatched or Received), month, and year. The dataset records the total weight of cargo and mail in tons for each type of shipment on a monthly basis throughout the year. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are cargo, air mail. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-08-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, transport network and mobility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
